notes_for_editor: Staffing: firelookout.com says staffed in the summer, undated; no year-by-year staffing history found in the sources. Access: the NRHP inventory says trail-accessible; whether visitors may enter the cab is not documented. Elevation: register 6,771 ft (2,064 m; record 2063.8 m follows it); firelookout.com 6,919 ft. Route below the lookout: the register names the Burlington Northern railroad and US 2; the nomination names the Roosevelt Highway and Great Northern Railway; not reconciled. The nomination PDF is a 1984 document (Historical Research Associates, June 1984, per Wikipedia) with 1982 interior photographs; 'good condition' is a 1984 statement. Glacier National Park's own lookout pages were not checked. The firelookout.com photos are credited to NPS staff without a license, so no photo was added.
